question: Does persistent demand and price acceptance during the completed V1 entry-signal session distinguish fixed MFE>=20% opportunities from the existing false-breakout class?
mechanism: A valid demand impulse should advance with lower path friction, spend more of the session accepted above volume-weighted price, and retain its first-30-minute attack rather than spike and reject.

interpretation_boundary.event: entry_signal_date completed session, which is the V1 retest-confirmation/entry-intent date and is not asserted to be the earlier lifecycle breakout date
forbidden: retrospective justification of an already-completed open fill
threshold, entry, exit, sizing, overlay, or production rule
order-book, queue, hidden-liquidity, participant-identity, or absorption claim beyond OHLCV proxies

population.other_cycles: retained for full-sample secondary endpoints but excluded from the fixed success-versus-false primary

data_contract.raw_source: QD-004 unadjusted one-minute OHLCV/amount, exact 2018-2025 annual inventory entries
data_contract.causal_gate: CY-008 daily hard-valid row and six hard-valid opening execution windows must agree exactly with the raw source
data_contract.session_grid: 241 rows: separate 09:30 auction bar plus 09:31..11:30 and 13:01..15:00 continuous-session bars
data_contract.flat_session_policy: if exact full-session price range and total path variation are zero, path efficiency=0, VWAP ties count 0.5, close location=0.5; preserve and disclose the row
data_contract.price_basis: raw/unadjusted CNY per share; within-session ratios only
data_contract.survivorship_boundary: fixed accepted V1 completed cycles; no inference about non-admitted or delisted securities

primary_predictor.name: signal_day_path_acceptance
primary_predictor.construction: equal-weight mean of entry-year percentile ranks of exactly three components

components.path_efficiency_1m: signed log(15:00 close / 09:31 open) divided by total absolute one-minute log-price variation, including the first 09:31 close/open move
components.time_above_session_vwap: fraction of 240 continuous-session closes strictly above full-session VWAP plus one-half of exact VWAP ties
components.opening_peak_retention: log(10:00 close / maximum high from 09:31 through 10:00); higher means less first-attack rejection

primary_predictor.expected_direction: positive for opportunity20 success relative to false breakout

outcomes.primary: breakout_success: 1 for existing opportunity20, 0 for existing false_breakout
secondary: opportunity20 in all 399 cycles, expected positive
non_false_breakout in all 399 cycles, expected positive
outcomes.independence: all predictors end on entry_signal_date; all primary outcomes begin after the T+1 execution open

primary_metrics: fixed-control partial Spearman rho and LOYO

falsification.bar_frequency_neighbor: replace only one-minute path efficiency with causally aggregated five-minute path efficiency
falsification.auction_neighbor: replace only one-minute path efficiency with a 09:30-auction-inclusive efficiency
tail_attacks: exclude Top-4 absolute realized P&L cycles
falsification.timing: 399/399 feature aggregates must be available at 15:30 before T+1 execution
falsification.daily_redundancy: primary effect must survive the frozen daily OHLC/amount controls

decision.VALIDATE: all raw, controlled, temporal, outcome-neighbor, and falsification gates pass
decision.SUPPORTED_WEAK: raw and controlled gates pass but at least one other gate fails

multiple_testing_control: one primary composite and one primary endpoint; components and two neighboring composites are fixed diagnostics and cannot replace the primary
